title: Chinese giants Xiaomi, Huawei race to get ahead of Apple’s rumored foldable iPhone
summary_full: Xiaomi and Huawei launched new foldables ahead of Apple’s event, where the company is rumored to unveil its first foldable iPhone.
summary_public: Xiaomi and Huawei launched new foldables ahead of Apple’s event, where the company is rumored to unveil its first foldable iPhone.
